experiments.study_type: In vitro cellular uptake of 68Ga/Atto495-labeled MSNPs
experiments.procedure_text: B16F10 or MDA-MB-231 cells incubated with 68Ga-MSNPs or Atto 495-MSNPs; analyzed by flow cytometry and confocal microscopy.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: Cells were incubated with 68 Ga-MSNPs or Atto 495-MSNPs at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for 30 minutes

experiments.exposure_evidence: Cells were incubated with 68 Ga-MSNPs or Atto 495-MSNPs at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for 30 minutes
experiments.notes: Cell-line based uptake study; no catalog endpoint fits nanoparticle uptake measurement.

experiments.study_type: In vitro cell-viability/cytotoxicity assay of MSNPs
experiments.procedure_text: B16F10 cells exposed to MSNPs at varying concentrations; viability determined via metabolic activity using CCK-8 assay 24 h later.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: To evaluate the cytotoxicity of MSNPs, cell viability was determined according to metabolic activity as a surrogate
experiments.test_system_evidence: B16F10 cells were seeded in 96-well plates

endpoints.label: cytotoxicity / cell viability
endpoints.evidence: To evaluate the cytotoxicity of MSNPs, cell viability was determined

experiments.study_type: In vitro cellular uptake and efflux of 68Ga by gamma counting
experiments.procedure_text: B16F10 cells incubated with 68Ga-labeled MSNPs; cellular uptake, retention and efflux kinetics assessed by bulk and single-cell gamma counting.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: Gamma counting was also used to study the cellular efflux of radioactivity
experiments.test_system_evidence: After incubation with 68 Ga-labeled MSNPs, B16F10 cells were washed
experiments.exposure_evidence: collecting the complete cell culture media at various time points (15 min, 30 min, 45 min, and 90 min)
experiments.notes: Single-cell measurements used individually sorted cells (n=50); efflux measured in triplicate.
